definition: The group of words for the marks the workbench draws on screen that are not a verdict on a house, each naming the one thing its mark means.
basis: schema/glossary-term.schema.json, the description of `family`, which lists the families in the order the Glossary page shows them: "`mark` holds the marks on screen that are not a judgment", and "Each value is bound by exactly one `family-<value>` record, whose term heads the group on the page."
